news_analysis.headline_hook: Tech purchase-ல 'Sealed Pack' இருந்தா safe-னு நினைக்கிறோமா? Fake Ryzen 9-ல Intel substrate வச்சு நடந்த hardware scam!
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Reports have emerged detailing a scam where counterfeit processors labeled as Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 were discovered inside factory-sealed packaging featuring an Intel substrate.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Buyers often believe that purchasing factory-sealed electronic components guarantees genuine hardware and protects their capital from counterfeit risks.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Sealed packaging can be spoofed or tampered with, meaning visual inspection of the outer box alone is insufficient proof of component authenticity.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Always purchase high-value hardware from authorized distributors and verify serial numbers directly through official manufacturer validation portals upon delivery.

carousel_outline.title: The Sealed-Box Trap
carousel_outline.takeaway: Counterfeit processors were found packaged inside seemingly intact sealed retail boxes.

carousel_outline.title: The Technical Discrepancy
carousel_outline.takeaway: The tampered units displayed AMD branding on the heat spreader but utilized an Intel substrate underneath.

carousel_outline.title: What Consumers Must Check
carousel_outline.takeaway: Relying purely on tamper seals is inadequate; verify internal substrate markings and invoice legitimacy before final acceptance.

news_analysis.editorial_directive: Use everyday tech-Tanglish. Emphasize that unopened/sealed boxes in retail tech purchases are no longer a 100% guarantee against counterfeit hardware.

slides.title: Sealed-Box CPU Scam: Fake Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Found With Intel Substrate

comparison_data.myth: Factory sealed box இருந்தா உள்ள இருக்கிற processor அப்பட்டமான original-னு நம்புறது.
comparison_data.reality: Sealed pack-ல வந்த அந்த Ryzen 9 CPU-க்குள்ள Intel substrate இருந்துச்சுங்கிறதுதான் அதிர்ச்சி உண்மை!

comparison_data.myth: கடைல வாங்கிட்டோம், packing பிரிக்கல, அதனால எந்த risk-ம் இல்ல.
comparison_data.reality: வெளியே இருக்கிற packaging-ஐ வச்சே ஏமாத்துறது இப்போ ரொம்ப சாதாரணமாப் போச்சு.
